blocks.text: When benzene burns in excess air it is completely oxidised to carbon dioxide and water: 2C6H6 + 15O2 -> 12CO2 + 6H2O. The flame is very smoky, which is used as a test for aromatic compounds.

blocks.prompt: Check that the combustion equation of benzene is balanced.
blocks.explanation: Left: 12 C, 12 H, 30 O. Right: 12 C in 12CO2; 12 H in 6H2O; 24 + 6 = 30 O. Balanced.

items: 2C6H6 + 15O2 -> 12CO2 + 6H2O; a smoky flame shows an aromatic compound.
